properties.description: The write side: set_interface_spec gains a tenth agreement axis — a small structure of quantity name to unit (not a free string and not an enum), on the provider's published boundary and on the consumer's required boundary. The read side: the seam-incompatibility check, which already compares paradigm, payload_format, auth and transport_security across a published/required pair, compares the two unit maps quantity by quantity and reports a disagreement; and the incomplete-published-contract finding names the axis when a boundary that carries quantities states no units. `unspecified` and absence read as UNKNOWN, never as agreement — the materialised-default trap (fact:a-materialised-default-defeats-a-completeness-check) applies to this axis as to the other nine. Unit strings compare by exact spelling in the first cut; whether a canonical unit vocabulary is needed is the brainstorm's option F, deliberately not taken first. Planned 2026-09-13.
properties.name: A published boundary declares the unit of each quantity it carries, and the seam check reports the two sides disagreeing or one side silent
